rationale: C09 plausibly supplied a concrete and extensive drafting template. The child repeats its opening GSP/HTS recital, determination language, and a distinctive operative sequence: Annex I article-eligibility modifications; Annex II changes to the Rates of Duty 1-Special subcolumn; Annex III country-specific exclusions; continuation of staged Canadian and Israeli reductions by replacing rates marked “CA” and “IL”; supersession of inconsistent prior directives; and dual-date effectiveness. C08 and C22 share substantial portions of the same machinery, but C09 is materially closer because it includes both the Canadian and Israeli staged-reduction provisions in nearly the same sequence and language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Pursuant to Title V of the Trade Act of 1974, as amended ... the President may designate specified articles provided for in the Harmonized Tariff Schedule ... as eligible for preferential tariff treatment under the Generalized System of Preferences ...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Pursuant to Title V of the Trade Act of 1974, as amended ... the President may designate specified articles provided for in the Harmonized Tariff Schedule ... as eligible for preferential tariff treatment under the Generalized System of Preferences ...
shared_material.explanation: Nearly verbatim opening recital establishes direct literal reuse.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In order to provide benefits under the GSP to specified designated eligible articles ... the HTS is modified as provided in Annex I ... [followed by] Rates of Duty 1-Special ... Annex II ... [and] general note 3(c)(ii)(D) ... Annex III
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In order to provide benefits under the GSP to specified designated eligible articles ... the HTS is modified as provided in Annex I ... [followed by] Rates of Duty 1-Special ... Annexes II ... [and] general note 3(c)(ii) ... Annex III
shared_material.explanation: The child preserves C09's ordered Annex I–III machinery for article eligibility, duty-column symbols, and country-specific treatment.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In order to provide for the continuation of previously proclaimed staged rate reductions on goods originating in the territory of Canada ... the rate of duty ... followed by the symbol “CA” ... shall be deleted and the rate ... in such Annex inserted in lieu thereof.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In order to provide for the continuation of previously proclaimed staged reductions on Canadian goods ... the rate of duty ... followed by the symbol “CA” ... shall be deleted and the rate ... in such Annex inserted in lieu thereof.
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive tariff-replacement mechanism is reused almost verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In order to provide for the continuation of previously proclaimed staged rate reductions for products of Israel ... the rate of duty ... followed by the symbol “IL” ... shall be deleted and the rate ... in such Annex inserted in lieu thereof.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In order to provide for the continuation of previously proclaimed staged reductions on products of Israel ... the rate of duty ... followed by the symbol “IL” ... shall be deleted and the rate ... in such Annex inserted in lieu thereof.
shared_material.explanation: A second country-specific staged-reduction clause repeats the same specialized language and placement, strongly supporting structural and literal templating.
